scope: Actual literal raw-R50 coupons proving complex atan2 including exact-zero denominator, projected conversion operands and complex CSV key conventions.
restrictions: Original incorrect hypotheses and pre-upgrade evaluator errors retained verbatim.
Two atan2(0,0) jobs log Loss=nan and empty high precision exports despite raw PEC fallback; these are invalid domain evidence, not verified physical comparisons.
Nonzero complex atan2 uses atan(y/x), adding +/-pi when real(x)<0 according to real(y); x==0,y!=0 returns pi/2+i*real(y), even for negative real y.
Conversion operands use finite real projection; table1 key and table2 column use real projection while table2 row uses signed magnitude.
Native m2p first hypothesis mistakenly used UM scaling in a MM project; later correct MM literal control retained independently.
Quoted CSV dependencies retain exact original bytes/hashes; each job is independent fresh native engine output.
Broader native STF/geometry/material and hierarchy contracts remain separate.
